fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company expects to consume approximately 1.4 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2010.

instrument_type_details.notes: Portfolio consists of purchased call options, collar structures (purchased call + sold put), call spreads (purchased call + sold call), and fixed-price swap agreements. Crude oil, heating oil, and unleaded gasoline-based derivatives used.

warnings: 2010 coverage percentage not explicitly stated in the standard table format; disclosed as approximately 50% at varying price levels with layered call option modifications. Net fair value of -$147M is net of $330M cash collateral (gross derivative liability $477M).
2011-2013 forward table provides gallons and forecast percentage of consumption but no explicit instrument type breakdown per year.
